c1_fact: Exposes CLI (obscura fetch/serve/scrape with --dump text/html/links, --eval, --screenshot), CDP server (obscura serve --port 9222, drop-in for Puppeteer/Playwright via ws://localhost:9222), and MCP server (docs/Use-the-MCP-server.md). All callable from TypeScript via puppeteer-core or playwright-core.
c2_fact: Single binary download via curl (no Chrome, no Node.js, no dependencies). Runs on Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu 22.04+, glibc 2.35+). Docker image available (~57MB compressed, distroless). Headless by default. No external infrastructure needed.
c4_fact: 70MB binary size, 30MB memory usage, instant startup, 85ms page load. No Chromium download needed (native V8 rendering). Extremely lightweight — significantly lighter than Playwright+Chromium.
source: README (manually analyzed, Ollama missed due to HTML-heavy README header)
